KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_HOSTING_MANDATE: Attend the court to discuss Royal Duties
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_HOSTING_MANDATE_BTN_T: Accepting your Royal Duties will have weary Royal Companies visiting your village.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_DESC:
Your Royal Courtier joins the opulent royal court and glimpses at the grand strategies of the realm. War rages along borders near your village, and the King has decided your castle would be the most suitable place for hosting and attending his weary Royal Companies.

The King promises you coins and influence if you accept these Royal Duties.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_CHOICE_A: Our castle is at your service, your Majesty.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_CHOICE_A_TOOLT: By accepting your Royal Duties, you must attend weary Royal Companies visiting your village.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_CHOICE_NO: We need to think about this.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_CHOICE_NO_TOOL: You can accept later by mandating your Royal Courtier again.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOMHOSTING_KINGSUMMON_OUTCOME_DESC: You have agreed to attend weary Royal Companies as part of Royal Duties. By meeting their needs, you will earn coins and influence.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_CAMPAIGN_MANDATE: Attend the court to discuss warfare
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_CAMPAIGN_MANDATE_BTN_: Agreeing to strengthen your army will eventually let you join military campaigns.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_KINGSTEP4_MANDATE: Attend the court to discuss a royal visit
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_KINGSTEP4_MANDATE_BTN: Agreeing to host royal visitors will give you significant prestige.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_HOSTING_PAUSE_MANDATE: Ask the court to pause Royal Duties
Asking to pause your Royal Duties will prevent Royal Companies from being hosted at your Castle. You can resume your Royal Duties with another mandate.
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_HOSTING_RESTART_MANDA: Ask the court to resume Royal Duties
KINGSUMMON_MANDATE.KINGDOM_KINGSUMMON_HOSTING_SWITCH_MANDAT: Requesting to restart your Royal Duties will result in Royal Companies visiting your Castle. You can pause your Royal Duties with another mandate.
